---
title: "RESY Maker"
---

Build an expert system: each vegetation type gets a rule of conditions on
species groups. As you build, RESY classifies a set of test plots with it.
Export the system for the [RESY App](app.html) or `resy_classify()`. Runs in
this browser tab through [webR](https://docs.r-wasm.org/webr/latest/); nothing
is uploaded.

```{=html}
<script type="module" src="../webr/resy_core.js"></script>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/leaflet.min.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="../webr/page.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="../webr/maker.css">
<div id="resy-app" class="maker">
  <div id="loader" role="status" aria-live="polite">
    <div class="hex">
      <img class="base" src="../logo.png" alt="">
      <img class="fill" id="hex-fill" src="../logo.png" alt="RESY">
    </div>
    <p id="loader-step">Starting R…</p>
  </div>

  <div id="tool" inert>
    <div class="top" id="top">
      <div class="bar">
        <input class="form-control form-control-sm title" id="m-scheme" data-meta="scheme" placeholder="Name of the system" aria-label="Name of the system" spellcheck="false">
        <input class="form-control form-control-sm version" id="m-version" data-meta="version" placeholder="Version" aria-label="Version" spellcheck="false">
        <div class="btn-group btn-group-sm" role="group" aria-label="Undo and redo">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="undo" title="Undo (Ctrl+Z)" disabled>Undo</button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="redo" title="Redo (Ctrl+Y)" disabled>Redo</button>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm" data-sheet="open" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="sheet-open">Open…</button>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm" id="save" title="Download the system as it is now, as a .json file to open again later. Unfinished types are kept.">Save</button>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm" data-sheet="clear" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="sheet-clear">Clear…</button>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-link btn-sm p-0 ms-auto" id="play-problems" data-sheet="export" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="sheet-export" aria-label="Review system checks"></button>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" data-sheet="export" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="sheet-export">Export…</button>
      </div>
      <div class="playbar">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" id="plots-open" data-sheet="plots" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="sheet-plots">Upload your plots</button>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-link btn-sm p-0" id="play-stats" data-act="show-plots" data-show="all"></button>
        <span id="play-status" class="small text-body-secondary" aria-live="polite"></span>
      </div>

      <div class="sheet card" id="sheet-open" hidden><div class="card-body">
        <p class="card-title h5">Open another system</p>
        <div class="choices">
          <label class="choice">
            <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="start" value="new" checked> An empty system
            <span class="hint">You add the types, their groups and the species.</span>
          </label>
          <label class="choice">
            <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="start" value="Apennine-test"> The Apennine example
            <span class="hint">A small system with fifteen species groups and nineteen types that fits the example plots.</span>
          </label>
          <label class="choice">
            <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="start" value="EUNIS"> EUNIS-ESy
            <span class="hint">European habitat types (Chytrý et al. 2020), to adapt to your region or data.</span>
            <select class="form-select form-select-sm mt-2" id="start-eunis-version" aria-label="EUNIS-ESy release"></select>
          </label>
          <label class="choice">
            <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="start" value="file"> An expert system file
            <span class="hint"><code>.json</code> or <code>.txt</code>, to continue or change it.</span>
            <input class="form-control form-control-sm mt-2" type="file" id="start-file" accept=".json,.txt">
          </label>
        </div>
        <div class="actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" id="start-go">Open</button>
          <span id="start-status" class="small text-body-secondary" aria-live="polite"></span>
        </div>
      </div></div>

      <div class="sheet card" id="sheet-clear" hidden><div class="card-body">
        <p class="card-title h5">Clear everything?</p>
        <p class="small mb-0" id="clear-text"></p>
        <div class="actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-danger" id="clear-go">Clear everything</button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary" id="clear-save">Save a copy first</button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" data-sheet="clear" data-autofocus>Cancel</button>
          <span id="clear-status" class="small text-body-secondary" aria-live="polite"></span>
        </div>
      </div></div>

      <div class="sheet card" id="sheet-match" hidden><div class="card-body">
        <p class="card-title h5">Add the names of the test plots</p>
        <div id="match-body"></div>
        <div class="actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" id="match-go" disabled>Add the names</button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" data-sheet="match">Cancel</button>
        </div>
      </div></div>

      <div class="sheet card" id="sheet-plots" hidden><div class="card-body">
        <p class="card-title h5">Your plots</p>
        <p class="small text-body-secondary" id="data-note"></p>
        <label class="form-label small d-block">Species file: one row per species in each plot
          <input class="form-control form-control-sm mt-1" type="file" id="f-species" accept=".csv,.tsv,.txt,text/csv"></label>
        <div class="colpick small">
          <label>Plot <select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="c-id"></select></label>
          <label>Species <select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="c-name"></select></label>
          <label>Cover (%) <select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="c-cover"></select></label>
        </div>
        <label class="form-label small d-block mt-2">Sites file: the plot column and the columns your rules read
          <input class="form-control form-control-sm mt-1" type="file" id="f-sites" accept=".csv,.tsv,.txt,text/csv"></label>
        <div class="actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" id="data-use" disabled>Test on these files</button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-link btn-sm p-0" id="data-example" hidden>Use the example plots again</button>
          <span id="data-status" class="small text-body-secondary" aria-live="polite"></span>
        </div>
      </div></div>

      <div class="sheet card" id="sheet-export" hidden><div class="card-body">
        <p class="card-title h5">Check</p>
        <ul class="problems" id="x-problems"></ul>
        <p class="small mb-0" id="x-check" aria-live="polite"></p>
        <p class="card-title h5 mt-4">Export</p>
        <label class="form-label small d-block">Description
          <input class="form-control form-control-sm mt-1" id="m-description" data-meta="description" placeholder="What the system classifies, and where"></label>
        <div class="actions mt-2">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" id="x-json">Download <code>.json</code></button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary" id="x-txt">Download <code>.txt</code></button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary" id="x-app">Classify your data with it in the RESY App</button>
          <span id="x-status" class="small text-body-secondary" aria-live="polite"></span>
        </div>
        <p class="small text-body-secondary mt-3 mb-1">The <code>.json</code> file is the format RESY reads directly. The <code>.txt</code> file has the layout of the EUNIS-ESy releases; RESY reads it back after writing it and compares it with the <code>.json</code> file. A system that starts from a shipped one needs its own name once you change it. In R:</p>
        <pre class="mb-0"><code id="x-snippet"></code></pre>
      </div></div>
    </div>

    <p class="small note welcome" id="welcome" hidden>
      <span>This is the Apennine example: a few vegetation types, each with a rule that is tested on the example plots. Change a rule and watch the plot counts, or start your own system under <b>Open…</b>.</span>
      <button type="button" class="mini x" id="welcome-x" title="Hide this note" aria-label="Hide this note">✕</button>
    </p>

    <div class="bench">
      <div class="card pane" id="pane-types"><div class="card-body">
        <div class="panehead">
          <div class="listhead">
            <p class="card-title h5 mb-0">Types</p>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" id="t-new">New type</button>
          </div>
          <input class="form-control form-control-sm mb-2" type="search" id="t-q" placeholder="Search the types" aria-label="Search the types">
        </div>
        <ul class="picklist" id="t-list"></ul>
        <ul class="picklist rest" id="t-rest"></ul>
        <p class="small lit" id="t-lit" hidden></p>
      </div></div>

      <div id="col-rule">
        <div id="t-mapbox" hidden>
          <div class="mapbar">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm" id="map-region" aria-pressed="false">Test on a region</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm" id="map-all" hidden>Test on all plots</button>
            <span class="small text-body-secondary" id="map-note" aria-live="polite"></span>
          </div>
          <div id="t-map" role="region" aria-label="Map of the test plots"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="card" id="pane-rule"><div class="card-body" id="t-editor"></div></div>
      </div>

      <div class="card pane" id="pane-parts"><div class="card-body">
        <div class="tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Groups, species and plots">
          <button type="button" class="tab" role="tab" id="tab-button-groups" aria-controls="tab-groups" data-tab="groups">Groups <span id="n-groups"></span></button>
          <button type="button" class="tab" role="tab" id="tab-button-species" aria-controls="tab-species" data-tab="species">Species <span id="n-species"></span></button>
          <button type="button" class="tab" role="tab" id="tab-button-plots" aria-controls="tab-plots" data-tab="plots">Plots <span id="n-plots"></span></button>
        </div>

        <div id="tab-groups" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-button-groups">
          <div class="listhead">
            <select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="g-filter" aria-label="Which groups to list"></select>
            <input class="form-control form-control-sm" type="search" id="g-q" placeholder="Search" aria-label="Search the groups">
          </div>
          <div class="listhead">
            <span id="g-count" class="small text-body-secondary"></span>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" id="g-new">New group</button>
          </div>
          <ul class="picklist" id="g-list"></ul>
        </div>

        <div id="tab-species" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-button-species" hidden>
          <div id="sp-backbone" hidden>
            <p class="small mb-2">The system matches species along a taxonomic backbone: a plot taxon counts for a species of the system when the backbone places it at or below that species, as a synonym, a subspecies or a member of an aggregate.</p>
            <div class="row g-2 mb-2">
              <label class="col-4 small">Backbone <input class="form-control form-control-sm" data-bb="name" aria-label="Name of the backbone"></label>
              <label class="col-5 small">Address <input class="form-control form-control-sm" data-bb="url" aria-label="Address of the backbone"></label>
              <label class="col-3 small">Version <input class="form-control form-control-sm" data-bb="version" aria-label="Version of the backbone"></label>
            </div>
            <div id="bb-names"></div>
            <div id="bb-test"></div>
          </div>
          <div id="sp-legacy">
          <p class="small note">This system lists its species and their synonyms itself. <button type="button" class="btn btn-link btn-sm p-0 align-baseline" id="sp-to-backbone">Match its species along EuroSL instead</button></p>
          <div class="actions mt-0">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" id="sp-paste-toggle">Add species…</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" id="sp-match" data-sheet="match" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="sheet-match" disabled>Add the names of the test plots…</button>
            <span class="info-tip" id="sp-info" hidden><button type="button" class="mini" aria-label="About these names" aria-describedby="sp-info-text">ⓘ</button><span class="bubble" role="tooltip" id="sp-info-text"></span></span>
          </div>
          <div id="sp-paste" hidden>
            <textarea class="form-control form-control-sm mt-2" id="sp-text" rows="5" placeholder="One species name per line" aria-label="Species names, one per line"></textarea>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm mt-2" id="sp-paste-add">Add to the list</button>
          </div>
          <div class="listhead mt-3 mb-2">
            <select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="sp-filter" aria-label="Which species to list"></select>
            <input class="form-control form-control-sm" type="search" id="sp-q" placeholder="Search" aria-label="Search the species list">
          </div>
          <div class="listhead mb-0">
            <span id="sp-count" class="small text-body-secondary"></span>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-danger btn-sm" id="sp-remove"></button>
          </div>
          <p class="small note" id="sp-removed" hidden><span id="sp-removed-text"></span> <button type="button" class="btn btn-link btn-sm p-0 align-baseline" id="sp-restore">Put them back</button></p>
          <ul class="species-list" id="sp-list"></ul>
          <nav class="invisible" id="sp-pages" aria-label="Species pages">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm" id="sp-prev">Previous</button>
            <span class="small text-body-secondary" id="sp-page" aria-live="polite"></span>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm" id="sp-next">Next</button>
          </nav>
          <div id="sp-notes"></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div id="tab-plots" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-button-plots" hidden>
          <select class="form-select form-select-sm mb-2" id="show" aria-label="Which plots to list"></select>
          <input class="form-control form-control-sm mb-2" type="search" id="q" placeholder="Filter by plot or type" aria-label="Filter the plots">
          <div class="tablewrap">
            <table class="table table-sm table-hover mb-0">
              <thead><tr><th>Plot</th><th>Type</th><th>Rules that hold</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody id="rows"></tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          <span id="shown" class="small text-body-secondary"></span>
          <details class="small text-body-secondary" id="notes" hidden>
            <summary id="notes-n"></summary>
            <ul class="warn" id="warnings"></ul>
          </details>
        </div>
      </div></div>
    </div>

    <div class="card mt-3" id="detail" hidden><div class="card-body">
      <div class="listhead">
        <p class="card-title h5 mb-0" id="d-title"></p>
        <button type="button" class="mini x" id="d-close" title="Close" aria-label="Close">✕</button>
      </div>
      <p id="d-status" class="small text-body-secondary mb-0" role="status"></p>
      <div id="d-body"></div>
    </div></div>

    <ul id="ta" class="typeahead" role="listbox" aria-label="Species suggestions" hidden></ul>
    <p id="footer" class="small text-body-secondary mt-3"><span id="draft-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></span></p>
  </div>
</div>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/leaflet.min.js"></script>
<script type="module" src="../webr/maker.js"></script>
```
